name: Keng Wei
bio: Keng Wei is dated by Giles to the 8th century AD. His poem here is an evening scene of loneliness in a village.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Lonely
poems.author: Keng Wei

poems.title: 秋日 (Qiu ri)
poems.author: Keng Wei
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
返照入閭巷，憂來誰共語。
古道少人行，秋風動禾黍。
